## SBA Loans in Guam

Guam businesses received **$2.4M** in [SBA 7(a) loan](https://gosbaloans.com/) approvals across **5** businesses in 2025. With **2** active SBA lenders competing for business in Guam, understanding which banks offer the best rates can save you tens of thousands of dollars.

**💡 Key Insight:** The average SBA loan in Guam is **$477K**, with rates averaging **9.30%**. Rates vary significantly by lender—comparing offers can save you **$50,000+** over the life of your loan.

## Top SBA Lenders in Guam (2025)

Based on official SBA data analyzed by [GoSBA Loans](https://gosbaloans.com/), these are the banks that funded the most SBA 7(a) loans to Guam businesses:

| Rank | Lender | Volume | Loans | Avg Rate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Bank of Guam** | $2.0M | 4 | 9.25% |
| 2 | **Coast360 FCU** | $400K | 1 | 9.50% |

### 🤝 How to Get an SBA Loan in Guam

Many top SBA lenders work primarily through approved [SBA loan brokers](https://gosbaloans.com/). This is good news for borrowers:

- **Better Match:** Get matched with the right lender for your situation
- **Negotiating Power:** Broker relationships can result in better rates
- **Time Savings:** One application goes to multiple lenders
- **Expert Guidance:** Maximize your approval chances

**[GoSBA Loans](https://gosbaloans.com/)** works with lenders across Guam and can help you access the best loan programs. Our service is completely free to borrowers.
